tools.description: The connected servers this workspace exposes to you, with the id a feed needs. tools.name: ledger_feeds_backfill
tools.description: Run the same frozen instruction over a past range, so a metric has history instead of starting the day it was set up. tools.name: ledger_feeds_delete
tools.description: Remove a feed. The readings it already wrote stay — the series is the record and outlives the instruction. Prefer pausing with ledger_feeds_update when the user might want it back. May return `needs_confirmation`.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "ledger" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_docs, ledger_plan_add, ledger_entries_draft, ledger_feed_sources_list, ledger_feeds_list, ledger_feeds_preview, comments_list, search_workspace · Private data: ledger_entries_create, ledger_metrics_record_reading, ledger_entries_add_evidence, ledger_plan_add, ledger_entries_draft, ledger_feeds_create, ledger_feeds_run, ledger_feeds_delete, search_workspace · Public sink: ledger_plan_add, ledger_feeds_preview · Destructive: ledger_entries_create, ledger_metrics_create, ledger_entries_add_evidence, ledger_plan_delete, ledger_feeds_list, ledger_feeds_update, ledger_feeds_run, ledger_feeds_backfill, ledger_feeds_delete, comments_create.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_docs, ledger_plan_add, ledger_entries_draft, ledger_feed_sources_list, ledger_feeds_list, ledger_feeds_preview, comments_list, search_workspace · Private data: ledger_entries_create, ledger_metrics_record_reading, ledger_entries_add_evidence, ledger_plan_add, ledger_entries_draft, ledger_feeds_create, ledger_feeds_run, ledger_feeds_delete, search_workspace · Public sink: ledger_plan_add, ledger_feeds_preview · Destructive: ledger_entries_create, ledger_metrics_create, ledger_entries_add_evidence, ledger_plan_delete, ledger_feeds_list, ledger_feeds_update, ledger_feeds_run, ledger_feeds_backfill, ledger_feeds_delete, comments_create

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
